title: Maximum Fixed Window Sum
summary: Return the largest sum among contiguous windows of exactly k values.
statement: Return the largest sum among contiguous windows of exactly k values. Implement `maximum_fixed_window_sum` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Adjacent fixed windows differ by one entering and one leaving value.
Update the sum in constant time as the right edge advances.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the maximum_fixed_window_sum invariant is complete.
Editorial: Update the sum in constant time as the right edge advances. The intended bounds are O(n) time and O(1) space.
